name: Saria
source:
Saria is the lead physician on the Hesperides station, and she is everything you would wish your doctor to be. Kind, mature and attentive, her patients and their wellbeing are her top priority. Her friends wish she would prioritize herself more though.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
